title: Generic monotone diagram and regular vertex generators
statement: Let $k$ have characteristic zero, let $M$ be a smooth finite-type $k$-scheme and $X\hookrightarrow M$ a closed subscheme [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-weil-closed-immersion]. At $a\in X$ take the Taylor extension $K_a\subset L[[T_1,\ldots,T_n]]$, $L=\kappa(a)$, of its ideal in an etale coordinate chart [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]. Order exponents lexicographically by $(|\alpha|,\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)$ and let $D$ be the exponents of first nonzero terms of elements of $K_a$. Coordinates can be chosen, after an etale localization and shrinking, so that $D$ is monotone: if $\alpha\in D$ and $i<j$, then $\alpha-\alpha_i e_i+\alpha_i e_j\in D$. Its finite vertices $\alpha_1<\cdots<\alpha_s$ can be lifted to regular generators $F_i$ of the ideal of $X$ on a neighbourhood of $a$, with initial Taylor exponent $\alpha_i$ and initial coefficient $1$. For any such lifts, if $d_i=|\alpha_i|$, their initial homogeneous forms have unique homogeneous division, for every prefix consisting of all vertices of degree at most a chosen bound: the quotient of $F_i$ is supported in $\Delta_i=\{\beta:\alpha_i+\beta\in(\alpha_i+\mathbf N^n)\setminus\bigcup_{j<i}(\alpha_j+\mathbf N^n)\}$ and the remainder outside the union of the prefix orthants. The Taylor ideal is generated with these supported quotients. For $K_a=0$ the vertex list is empty.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-generic-monotone-vertex-chart] to construct the geometric chart and normalized regular vertex generators. Keep its actual Taylor ideal and diagram; no choices are made inside a definition.

For an arbitrary regular lift family G satisfying the coefficient-one and earlier-coefficient-vanishing hypotheses, its Taylor series have the prescribed first exponents. Restrict this family to each degree prefix and apply [lem-trf-initial-exponent-homogeneous-division] to obtain HasUniqueDivision in every homogeneous degree.

Apply [lem-trf-supported-formal-division] to the full Taylor lift family. The remainder belongs to the Taylor ideal, since the dividend and the finite sum of quotient multiples do. If nonzero, well-foundedness of degree-lex on finitely many variables gives its least nonzero exponent. Membership in the ideal puts that exponent in the actual diagram, while the remainder support puts it outside the generated diagram, which is equal to the actual one. This contradiction makes the remainder zero. Convert Function.support to the existing supported predicate to obtain the stated supported generation for every lift family. The well-founded minimum is the Mathlib WellFounded.has_min applied to DegLex.

If the Taylor ideal is zero and s is nonzero, take index 0. The ordered-vertex characterization makes its vertex a member of the actual diagram. Its defining witness is a member of the zero ideal with a nonzero coefficient, a contradiction. Assemble the unchanged GenericMonotoneDiagram structure with these universal division and empty-family conclusions.
